title: Fantastically Optimised (Vulkan)
description: This modpack adds VulkanMods and other Performance Mods in one Modpack
body:
# Fantastically Optimised

*A high-performance Fabric modpack for Minecraft 26.1.2*

---

## 🚀 About

Fantastically Optimised is a performance-focused Fabric modpack built around **VulkanMod**, replacing Minecraft's default OpenGL renderer with Vulkan for significantly improved GPU utilization and smoother gameplay on modern hardware.

Designed to maximize FPS, reduce stuttering, decrease memory usage, and improve world loading speeds while maintaining stability and compatibility.

---

### 📈 Performance Comparison

```text id="d3h4hh"
Vanilla Minecraft        █████████ 34 FPS
Fantastically Optimised  █████████████████████████████████ 132 FPS
```


* **+98 FPS**
* **~3.9× Faster**
* **~288% Higher FPS**


> Tested on the same system and settings. Actual performance may vary depending on hardware, drivers, render distance, and installed resource packs.

---

## 📦 Included Mods

| Mod               | Description                                            |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| VulkanMod         | Vulkan-based renderer replacing OpenGL                 |
| Lithium           | Server-side game logic optimizations                   |
| C2ME              | Faster chunk loading and generation                    |
| FerriteCore       | Reduced RAM usage                                      |
| MoreCulling       | Skips rendering hidden faces                           |
| Dynamic FPS       | Reduces resource usage when unfocused                  |
| Alternate Current | Optimized redstone engine                              |
| Krypton           | Network stack optimizations                            |
| BadOptimizations  | Additional performance tweaks                          |
| Noisium           | Faster world generation                                |
| Not Enough Vulkan | Vulkan compatibility fixes                             |
| ModernFix         | General performance, memory, and loading optimizations |
| Cull Leaves       | Improves FPS by culling hidden leaf faces              |
| Borderless Vulkan | Borderless fullscreen support for VulkanMod            |

---

## ⚠️ Requirements

* Minecraft **26.1.2**
* **Fabric Loader**
* A GPU with **Vulkan support**
* Updated graphics drivers

---

## ❗ Compatibility

Because this modpack uses **VulkanMod**, the following are **not compatible**:

* Sodium
* Iris
* Most shader mods
* Other renderer replacement mods

---

## 🎯 Goal

Provide the highest possible FPS while keeping Minecraft lightweight, stable, and visually faithful to the vanilla experience.
